The budget is excluded from the seed. This row RNG strategy does not require agreement with the historical batch-eight generation prefixes. Cross-budget prefix equality is measured rather than assumed.
selection_algorithm: Start from the frozen 2063-row Primary test population, exclude the ten rows in the 2026-10-13 diagnostic manifest. For each computed_hop=1..5, sort the remaining rows by SHA256 UTF-8 of stage-b2-3-budget100|20261014|<computed_hop>|<integer row_id>, breaking ties by integer row_id; take the first twenty.
parser: Frozen final-line parser applied only AFTER an observed generated </think> token boundary; missing/ambiguous boundary is INVALID
independence: Every budget runs generate from the original prompt; no generated-prefix reuse
inference_boundary: 100 equal-hop inputs, excluding the ten diagnostic pilot inputs; estimate conditional budget effects/completion/runtime, not the natural Primary hop mixture or seed variability
